subject: Fixed-form reference format
notes: Rule (§6.3.4 3): "All spaces." cite.py --check 6.3.4 "All spaces" -> OK §6.3.4 3). Code: a line shorter than 7 columns becomes an empty output line (AppendLine()). A line whose program-text area is all spaces goes through the default arm: StripInlineComment, then TrimEnd, which gives an empty line. Probe ffp15 has blank lines of 0 characters, 6 spaces, 7 characters, and a sequence number followed by 66 spaces, placed between division headers and inside the PROCEDURE DIVISION. It compiles and prints BLANKS-OK. The all-spaces line breaks only when it falls between the parts of a continued literal (ffp2 crash). That is §6.3.5's interspersing rule and is recorded under SR-6.3.5-1 and SR-6.3.5-2 (finding F1).
